title: 底部填膠流動控制
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入毛細流動、填料與固化應力。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore capillary flow, fillers and cure stress, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 間隙與潤濕
stages.description: 針對間隙與潤濕完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for gap and wetting, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 間隙幾何｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Gap geometry | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對間隙幾何，把「局部間隙和凸塊障礙控制流動阻力。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For gap geometry, turn "Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「間隙幾何」的模型：局部間隙和凸塊障礙控制流動阻力。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫最窄通道及流動分岔。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for gap geometry: Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫最窄通道及流動分岔。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean gap to predict every fill time. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付間隙幾何的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for gap geometry, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫最窄通道及流動分岔。 必須排除的錯判：平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean gap to predict every fill time. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「間隙幾何」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For gap geometry — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 局部間隙和凸塊障礙控制流動阻力。
平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間
四邊同時出膠總比單邊更無空洞
optionsEn: Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance.
Using mean gap to predict every fill time
Assuming four-sided dispensing always eliminates voids

quiz.explanationEn: Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance. Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Therefore reject: Using mean gap to predict every fill time.

steps.title: 間隙幾何｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Gap geometry | evidence and diagnosis

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫最窄通道及流動分岔。 將「平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Challenge the hypothesis "Using mean gap to predict every fill time" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫最窄通道及流動分岔。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean gap to predict every fill time. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付間隙幾何的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for gap geometry: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 返修與驗收｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Rework and acceptance | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對返修與驗收，把「可返修性、熱導及機械保護之間有權衡。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For rework and acceptance, turn "Reworkability, thermal conduction and mechanical protection trade off." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：按產品邊界列雙重驗收條件。 將「填滿且固化即滿足所有封裝需求」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Define paired acceptance criteria for product boundaries. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming filled and cured meets every package need" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 按產品邊界列雙重驗收條件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Define paired acceptance criteria for product boundaries. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：填滿且固化即滿足所有封裝需求。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming filled and cured meets every package need. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付返修與驗收的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for rework and acceptance: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
